what: BWD-LONG (2026-10-22): the attention backward at long context, every value as it was -- BWD-BAND (once a row of P spans a 4 KB page, the transposed products dV = P^T dY and dK = dS^T Q run a band of 32 rows of P at a time, every block a band reaches taking the band's terms, its sums stored between bands) and DP-PANEL (past the KV head's whole transposed panel, each probability-adjoint tile's values transposed into the tile's own panel for the register blocks, not the GEMM kernel) -- measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes, the backward with both builds in one process, the decoder's training step, the backward's phases, and the GEO study's attention model's training update built as the study builds it, against PyTorch; and the prototype runs that chose the band's height, its threshold and the tiles' panels, and found BWD-FUSE not worth taking.
